encounterDirector.layout: Hybrid cc65 C Director + stable ca65 ABI veneer

glue.transport: 4.5M-M2: offset $F8 of the merged low-C/GLUE LZ record

mergedRecord.consumedBy: publish_director_abi -> DIRECTOR_PUBLISH_LOW, stage_glue_holding; all before unpack_entity_runtime expands $9100-$9D5D

sectorReader.transport: own DFMC record, RAW, direct landing at $A000

levels.origin: read over SIO at START GAME

saveRecord.shipped: empty (all zero): BEST reads -- until the player earns one

diskGuard.record: the Light kernel's DFMC record (owner Q2: +1 extension sector)
diskGuard.fold: per accepted sector: a += its SIO carry-wrap sum; b += a + carry (16-bit)

claim.owner: owner answers Q-B5 and Q7: the region charset, slot C, the scratch page, slot D; the boss sector only

lightKernel.transport: own checked DFMC record, LZ, held until loader bitmap unpack

window.transport: second LZ stream of the pickup/collision record

arena.anchor: hybrid_arena_anchor (1-B rts, HYBRID_ASM_ARENA): keeps the record non-empty
arena.replaces: HYBRID_C_HEAVY window $7E12-$7F04 (243 B) and its 44-B transport tail in the merged low-C/GLUE record

boundedBy.below: starfield stream A staging / pause-screen backup end $7BD0

transport.record: own DFMC record, LZ, stagingId extension
transport.landing: direct: stage 2 decodes it to $7BD0; no hold, no publish copy

basicWindow.availability: unconditional: disable_basic_rom forces PORTB bit 1 and writes BASICF at every stage-2 entry

boundedBy.above: sector reader BSS $BC00-$BC19, then the guard and the OS screen $BC20-$BFFF (RAMTOP $C0 when BASIC is disabled at coldstart)

basicWindow.guard: HYBRID_C_WINDOW_GUARD $BC1A-$BC1F, reserved with no segment, plus the ld65 assert "HYBRID_C_WINDOW reaches the sector reader BSS at $BC00"

transport.record: own DFMC record, LZ, stagingId extension
transport.landing: direct: stage 2 decodes it to AE00 after disable_basic_rom

starfieldRuntime.compression: LZ-10/5, two independent streams expanded into one continuous destination

streams.copy: one resident 960-B pause-screen copy (copy_pause_screen), exact window, no spill
one resident 960-B pause-screen copy (copy_pause_screen), exact window, no spill

supersedes.note: 4.5M-M1 keeps the single-stream content headroom (+14 B to the hard gate, -7 B to the open correction-gate decision) on top of the measured two-stream total; the staging windows (960 + 1,032 B) are physical limits, not a budget

runtimeCodeBudget.measurement: linked CODE + STARFIELD + BROADSIDE + A2_KERNEL + ENTITY_CODE + PICKUP_CODE bytes

core.home: per-level image, behind the hull block

payload.home: per-level image, behind the core page

geometry.home: per-level image, behind the payload page

levelBlock.home: per-level image, behind the gameplay music block

channelAllocation.role: bass: buzz root / pure octave bounce
drums: kick (buzz sweep), snare and hat (noise)

reservedSfxChannels.role: capital-hull explosion and Player Fighter shot

placement.home: per-level image, behind the eight-byte header

runtimeTiming.method: NMOS-6502 execution of linked release bytes with replayed legal gameplay sessions

estimatedAdditive.classification: diagnostic estimate only; not a measured PAL frame or physical headroom

maximumProjectilePool.origin: coherent fixed-pool stress fixture cloned from a legal director frame

threeBroadside.origin: synthetic fixed-pool cycle stress; excluded from natural gameplay evidence

entityEffects.measurement: inclusive JSR-to-RTS cycles from executed linked release bytes

destructibleDebris.measurement: linked target dispatch versus the unchanged enemy-only entry

enemyBreakupEffects.measurement: linked release Raider death with no character-effect allocation

replay.input: release FIRE for one frame, then deterministic held-FIRE neutral/sweep/evasive joystick policies

limitations: The legal-heavy result is the maximum of bounded deterministic replays, not a proof over every possible input history.
CPU counts execute the linked NMOS 6502 bytes with DMA disabled for before/after comparison.
estimatedAdditive is a diagnostic bus-budget sum, not a measured PAL frame and never a physical headroom value.

The window under the BASIC ROM is unconditional RAM (owner decision B) and the build owns $A000-$BC1F, but no runtime range uses it yet, so it contributes nothing to the runtime ranges or the CPU accounting.
